eval_recalls: calculate object detection recalls from ground truth boxes and proposals with configurable IoU thresholds
print_recall_summary: print a formatted ASCII table summarizing recall values across proposal numbers and IoU thresholds
plot_num_recall: plot a Proposal_num-Recalls curve showing recall as a function of the number of proposals
plot_iou_recall: plot an IoU-Recalls curve showing recall as a function of IoU threshold values
set_recall_param: validate and normalize proposal_nums and iou_thrs inputs into numpy arrays for recall evaluation
